I have the full picture. Let me confirm the concrete type count — there's just the one unexported `service` struct implementing `markdown.Service`.

## h13.

**impl** — There is exactly one concrete implementation: the unexported struct `service` in `internal/markdown/markdown.go:58` (`type service struct { md goldmark.Markdown }`). It implements every method of the `Service` interface (`internal/markdown/markdown.go:31`), wrapping the `goldmark` library. No other type implements this interface at runtime.

**construction** — `markdown.NewService(...)` (`internal/markdown/markdown.go:85`) returns `&service{...}`. At runtime it is constructed exactly once, inside `NewAPIV1Service` (`server/router/api/v1/v1.go:48-51`), with `WithTagExtension()` and `WithMentionExtension()` enabled. That single instance is then passed by reference to the other holders — no separate production construction exists (`test/test_helper.go:44` is the only other call, and it's test-only).

**holders** — Components with a `markdown.Service` field, all fed from the one instance created in `NewAPIV1Service`:
- `APIV1Service.MarkdownService` — `server/router/api/v1/v1.go:35` (the owner; created here and used in `memo_service.go`, `memo_mention_helpers.go`, `memo_service_webhooks.go`).
- `RSSService.MarkdownService` — `server/router/rss/rss.go:45`, wired in `server/server.go:85` by passing `apiV1Service.MarkdownService` into `rss.NewRSSService(...)`.
- `memopayload.Runner.MarkdownService` — `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:16`. Note: this struct/`NewRunner` is **not** instantiated in production wiring (only its free function `RebuildMemoPayload(ctx, memo, s.MarkdownService)` is called from `memo_service.go:108,447`, passing the interface directly); the `Runner` holder is effectively unused at runtime outside tests.

The interface is also passed as a parameter (not held as a field) to `memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload` (`server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:74`) and `memopayload.NewRunner` (line 19).
